matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.name_base: Capital Airport to Qianmen (Matilde arrival - primary route)
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.name_local: 首都机场至前门（Matilde抵达——推荐路线）
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.type_local: 首都机场快轨 + 地铁2号线
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.departure_point_base: Terminal 2 Station (T2) or Terminal 3 Station (T3) - Beijing Capital Airport Express (首都机场快轨)
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.departure_point_local: 2号航站楼站（T2）或3号航站楼站（T3）——首都机场快轨
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.arrival_point_base: Qianmen Station (前门站) - Line 2 Exit C
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.status_base: No booking required - pay at machine
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.notes_base: RECOMMENDED ARRIVAL ROUTE (Capital Airport). Step 1: Take Beijing Capital Airport Express (首都机场快轨) from T2 or T3 station to Dongzhimen Station (东直门站), ~30 min, 25 CNY. Step 2: Transfer to Metro Line 2 (地铁2号线) inbound (内环) direction towards Qianmen. Ride 6 stops: Dongzhimen (东直门) → Dongsi Shitiao (东四十条) → Chaoyangmen (朝阳门) → Jianguomen (建国门) → Beijing Station (北京站) → Chongwenmen (崇文门) → Qianmen (前门). ~15 min, ~4 CNY. Total: ~58 min, ~35 CNY. Exit at Qianmen Station (前门站) Exit C (C口) - walk south ~5 min to Qianmen Street / hotel area. Note: Luggage is manageable on metro but if 2+ large suitcases, consider Didi from airport (~150-200 CNY, 60-90 min with traffic). May 2 (Labour Day) traffic can be heavy.
matilde_arrival_capital_airport_to_qianm.notes_local: 推荐抵达路线（首都机场）。第一步：乘坐首都机场快轨从T2或T3站至东直门站，约30分钟，25元。第二步：换乘地铁2号线内环方向，乘6站：东直门→东四十条→朝阳门→建国门→北京站→崇文门→前门，约15分钟，约4元。全程约58分钟，合计约35元。从前门站C口出，步行约5分钟即到前门大街/住宿区。注意：如携带2件以上大行李，建议从机场乘滴滴，约150-200元，60-90分钟（视五一节交通而定）。

matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.name_base: Daxing Airport to Qianmen (Matilde arrival - alternative if flight lands at PKX)
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.name_local: 大兴机场至前门（Matilde抵达——若航班落地大兴）
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.type_base: Daxing Airport Express + Metro Line 19 + Metro Line 14 + Metro Line 8
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.type_local: 大兴机场线 + 地铁19号线 + 地铁14号线 + 地铁8号线
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.route_number: Daxing Airport Express + Line 19 + Line 14 + Line 8
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.departure_point_base: Daxing Airport Station (大兴机场站) - Daxing Airport Express (大兴机场线)
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.departure_point_local: 大兴机场站——大兴机场线
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.status_base: No booking required - pay at machine
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.notes_base: ALTERNATIVE if flight lands at Daxing Airport (PKX). Step 1: Daxing Airport Express (大兴机场线) from Daxing Airport Station (大兴机场站) to Caogiao Station (草桥站), ~26 min, 35 CNY. Step 2: Transfer to Line 19 (地铁19号线) north to Jingfengmen Station (景风门站). Step 3: Transfer to Line 14 to Yongdingmen Wai Station (永定门外站). Step 4: Transfer to Line 8 (地铁8号线) north to Qianmen Station (前门站). Total: ~113 min, ~40 CNY. Given the longer journey, Didi from Daxing Airport is more practical: ~180-250 CNY, ~70-90 min depending on traffic. Check which airport your flight uses before travel.
matilde_arrival_daxing_airport_to_qianme.notes_local: 若航班降落大兴机场（PKX）备用路线。第一步：大兴机场线从大兴机场站至草桥站，约26分钟，35元。第二步：换乘19号线北行至景风门站。第三步：换乘14号线至永定门外站。第四步：换乘8号线北行至前门站。全程约113分钟，约40元。考虑到换乘较多，建议从大兴机场直接乘滴滴，约180-250元，70-90分钟。出发前请确认航班到达哪个机场。

matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.name_base: Beijing South Station to Qianmen (if arriving by HSR)
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.name_local: 北京南站至前门（若乘高铁抵京）
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.type_local: 地铁14号线 + 地铁8号线
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.departure_point_base: Beijing South Station (北京南站) - Metro Line 14 and Line 4 hub
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.departure_point_local: 北京南站（地铁4号线/14号线枢纽）
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.status_base: No booking required - pay at machine
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.notes_base: USE THIS if connecting via high-speed train to Beijing South (e.g., from Tianjin, Nanjing). Very convenient: Line 14 from Beijing South Station (北京南站) to Yongdingmen Wai Station (永定门外站) - 1 stop (~5 min), then transfer to Line 8 (地铁8号线) north 2 stops to Qianmen Station (前门站). Total ~30 min, ~5 CNY. Very close - alternative is a 20 min walk or Didi (~20 CNY).
matilde_arrival_beijing_south_station_to.notes_local: 若从高铁抵达北京南站（如从天津、南京转乘），非常便利：乘地铁14号线从北京南站至永定门外站（1站，约5分钟），换乘8号线北行2站至前门站。全程约30分钟，约5元。也可步行约20分钟或乘滴滴（约20元）。

jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.name_base: Wudaokou to Qianmen (Jade from home area)
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.name_local: 五道口至前门（Jade从住所出发）
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.type_local: 地铁13号线 + 地铁2号线
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.departure_point_base: Wudaokou Station (五道口站) - Metro Line 13
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.departure_point_local: 五道口站（地铁13号线）B南口
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.arrival_point_base: Qianmen Station (前门站) - Line 2 Exit C
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.status_base: No booking required - pay at machine
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.notes_base: Jade's route from Wudaokou home area. Step 1: Metro Line 13 (地铁13号线) from Wudaokou Station (五道口站) Exit B south towards Xizhimen (西直门方向), ride 3 stops: Wudaokou (五道口) → Zhichunlu (知春路) → Dazhongsi (大钟寺) → Xizhimen (西直门), ~10 min. Step 2: Transfer to Metro Line 2 (地铁2号线) outer loop (外环) direction, ride 7 stops: Xizhimen (西直门) → Chegongzhuang (车公庄) → Fuchengmen (阜成门) → Fuxingmen (复兴门) → Changchunjie (长椿街) → Xuanwumen (宣武门) → Hepingmen (和平门) → Qianmen (前门), ~18 min. Total: ~47 min, ~5 CNY. Jade can coordinate to meet Matilde at Qianmen area after Matilde checks into hotel.
jade_wudaokou_to_qianmen.notes_local: Jade从五道口住所出发。第一步：地铁13号线从五道口站（B南口）乘至西直门，途经知春路、大钟寺，约10分钟。第二步：换乘地铁2号线外环，从西直门乘至前门（途经车公庄、阜成门、复兴门、长椿街、宣武门、和平门），约18分钟。全程约47分钟，约5元。Jade可在Matilde办理入住后在前门区域会合。

qianmen_area_didi_option.name_base: Didi/Taxi within Qianmen area (luggage or late night)
qianmen_area_didi_option.name_local: 前门区域滴滴/出租车（行李或深夜使用）
qianmen_area_didi_option.departure_point_base: Yangmeizhu Xiejie Hutong (杨梅竹斜街) or Dashilar (大栅栏)
qianmen_area_didi_option.status_base: No booking required - use Didi app
qianmen_area_didi_option.notes_base: Didi recommended for: (1) Airport arrival with heavy luggage, (2) Late evening return after hutong walk (after 21:00), (3) Any time it is raining. Within the Qianmen/Dashilar/Yangmeizhu area itself, walking is genuinely the best option - streets are pedestrian or too narrow for cars. Note: Dashilar and Yangmeizhu Xiejie hutong lanes are pedestrian only. Didi pickup point should be on the main road (Qianmen Dajie 前门大街 or Meishi Jie 煤市街). Estimate: ~15 CNY for short rides within the district. Download Didi app and register with international phone number before arrival.
qianmen_area_didi_option.notes_local: 以下情况建议使用滴滴：（1）机场抵达携带大件行李；（2）晚间胡同游结束后（21:00后）；（3）下雨天。前门/大栅栏/杨梅竹斜街区域内步行是最佳选择——街道为步行街或胡同，车辆无法进入。注意：大栅栏和杨梅竹斜街为纯步行街，滴滴上车点应在主干道（前门大街或煤市街）。区内短途约15元。出发前请下载滴滴APP并用国际手机号注册。

andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.to_local: 慕田峪长城景区停车场
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.name_local: 滴滴/出租车前往慕田峪长城（去程）
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.type_local: 滴滴快车 / 滴滴优享
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.cost_type_local: 网约车（两人分摊，约110-125元/人）
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.departure_point_local: 安定门/鼓楼大街区域（住宿处上车）
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.arrival_point_base: Mutianyu Great Wall Scenic Area Parking Lot
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.arrival_point_local: 慕田峪长城景区停车场
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.status_base: No booking required - use Didi app
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.status_local: 无需预订，使用滴滴APP叫车
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.notes_base: Recommended: Didi Express or Didi Premier. Distance ~75 km, estimated ~90 min via G6 Jingzang Expressway. One-way cost ~200-250 CNY total (~100-125 CNY per person split between Matilde and Jade). Book via Didi app at hotel departure. Depart by 07:30 to arrive before crowds (peak Labour Day holiday). Note: Didi drivers may be unfamiliar with Mutianyu - specify destination as Mutianyu Great Wall Scenic Area Parking Lot (慕田峪长城景区停车场) in the app. Accept Didi Premier for slightly faster route selection. IMPORTANT: May 3 is a peak Labour Day holiday weekend - surge pricing may apply, expect fares up to 250-300 CNY total.
andingmen_to_mutianyu_didi.notes_local: 推荐使用滴滴快车或滴滴优享。全程约75公里，走京藏高速（G6）约90分钟。单程费用约200-250元/车次（两人分摊约100-125元/人）。在住宿处通过滴滴APP叫车出发。建议07:30前出发，赶在游客高峰前抵达（五一劳动节假期人流量大）。输入目的地时请填写慕田峪长城景区停车场。注意：5月3日为五一假期高峰，可能有溢价，预计总费用250-300元。

mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.name_local: 滴滴/出租车从慕田峪长城返回（回程）
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.type_local: 滴滴快车 / 滴滴优享
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.cost_type_local: 网约车（两人分摊，约110-125元/人）
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.departure_point_base: Mutianyu Great Wall Scenic Area Parking Lot
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.departure_point_local: 慕田峪长城景区停车场
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.status_base: No booking required - use Didi app
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.status_local: 无需预订，使用滴滴APP叫车
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.notes_base: Return ride from Mutianyu to Drum Tower / Shichahai area for dinner. Distance ~75 km, ~90 min via G6 Expressway. One-way cost ~200-250 CNY total (~100-125 CNY per person). Didi signal at Mutianyu parking lot is generally good. Depart by 16:00 to avoid heaviest evening traffic returning from the Wall. Destination: Gulou Dajie / Shichahai for dinner in the area. Note: On holiday return traffic (May 3 afternoon), journey may extend to 100-120 min - plan dinner reservation after 18:00.
mutianyu_to_drum_tower_didi.notes_local: 从慕田峪长城返回鼓楼/什刹海用晚餐。全程约75公里，走京藏高速约90分钟，费用约200-250元/车次（两人分摊约100-125元/人）。慕田峪停车场信号良好，可顺利叫车。建议16:00出发以避开傍晚返城高峰。目的地填写鼓楼大街/什刹海。注意：五一假期3日下午返城拥堵，行程可能延长至100-120分钟，建议晚餐预约18:00以后。

mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.name_base: Chartered Driver - Full Day (Mutianyu Great Wall alternative)
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.name_local: 包车司机一日游（慕田峪长城备选方案）
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.type_base: Chartered private car / driver for the day
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.type_local: 包车/私人司机全天服务
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.cost_type_base: Full day charter (~500-600 CNY total, ~250-300 CNY per person)
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.cost_type_local: 全天包车（约500-600元/车，两人各约250-300元）
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.company_base: Private driver (booked via Didi Day-Use or local hostel)
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.company_local: 私人司机（通过滴滴日租或青旅预订）
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.arrival_point_local: 安定门/鼓楼区域住宿（返回）
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.status_base: Book in advance via hostel / Didi Day-Use
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.status_local: 提前通过青旅或滴滴日租预订
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.notes_base: ALTERNATIVE to two separate Didi rides: Hire a driver for the full day (~500-600 CNY total for both, round trip with wait time at the Wall). This is more convenient on a holiday peak day (May 3) when Didi surge pricing may push individual rides to 250-300 CNY each. Full-day charter includes: morning pickup ~07:30 -> drive to Mutianyu -> wait 4-5 hours at the Wall -> return ~16:00-17:00. Book via: (1) Didi Day-Use feature in the app, (2) Your hostel reception - many budget hostels in the Gulou area can arrange this, (3) Local drivers near Mutianyu entrance. Confirm destination as 慕田峪长城 round trip. Cost per person ~250-300 CNY (~41 USD) is competitive vs two separate Didi rides on a peak day.
mutianyu_full_day_driver_alternative.notes_local: 推荐备选方案：整天包车（约500-600元/辆，两人分摊，含在长城等候时间）。五一3日高峰期滴滴溢价可能导致单程费用高达250-300元，届时包车反而更划算。全天包车行程：早上约07:30出发→慕田峪长城→等候4-5小时→约16:00-17:00返回。预订方式：（1）滴滴APP内的日租功能；（2）通过鼓楼区域青旅前台预订（当地青旅通常可安排）；（3）慕田峪景区入口附近的私人司机。费用约250-300元/人（约41美元），五一高峰期性价比高于两次单独叫车。

location_change.notes_base: Book on 12306.cn or Trip.com. Departs Beijing North (not Beijing South). Recommend early morning departure to maximize time at Yungang Grottoes. Book at least 2 weeks in advance during Golden Week period (Labour Day holiday). Both Matilde and Jade travel together.
location_change.notes_local: 在12306.cn或携程订票。从北京北站出发（非北京南站）。建议尽早出发以充分游览云冈石窟。劳动节假期期间建议提前至少两周购票。Matilde和Jade同行。

datong_to_beijing_evening.name_local: 大同 → 北京（傍晚返程）
datong_to_beijing_evening.notes_base: Both Matilde and Jade return to Beijing in the evening after visiting Hanging Monastery. Depart Datong South ~17:37, arrive Beijing North ~20:28 (171 min). Book together with Day 3 outbound ticket on 12306.cn.
datong_to_beijing_evening.notes_local: Matilde和Jade傍晚参观悬空寺后一同返京。大同南站约17:37出发，约20:28抵达北京北站（171分钟）。与第3天出发票一同在12306.cn购买。

location_change.arrival_point_base: Chengdu Tianfu International Airport (TFU) or Shuangliu (CTU)
location_change.arrival_point_local: 成都天府国际机场（TFU）或双流（CTU）
location_change.notes_base: Matilde only - Jade has class in Beijing. Morning flight 07:45-10:25 (approx 160 min). Alternative options: 13:30 flight (arr 16:15) if morning feels rushed. Price EUR 301 per person (~CNY 2380 / USD 328). Allow 2h airport transfer time. Taxi/express train to airport from city center takes ~1h. Book via Trip.com or airline website. HSR Beijing-Chengdu would take ~10h+ (not recommended). Price is approximate based on Duffel search April 2026.
location_change.notes_local: 仅Matilde搭乘——Jade在北京上课。早班机07:45-10:25（约160分钟）。如早晨时间紧，可选13:30航班（16:15抵达）。票价约301欧元/人（约2380元人民币/328美元）。请预留2小时机场中转时间。市区至机场约需1小时（出租车/机场快线）。可通过携程或航空公司官网购票。

jade_beijing_to_chengdu.name_local: 北京 → 成都（Jade，第6天早晨）
jade_beijing_to_chengdu.notes_base: Jade flies Beijing to Chengdu on May 7 (Day 6) to rejoin Matilde. Morning flight 07:45 recommended to arrive in time for Leshan Giant Buddha day trip. Same route as Matilde's May 6 flight. Book separately as it is a different date. EUR 301 per person (~USD 328). Allow 2h before departure for airport check-in.
jade_beijing_to_chengdu.notes_local: Jade于5月7日（第6天）从北京飞往成都与Matilde会合。推荐早班机07:45出发，可赶上乐山大佛一日游。与Matilde的5月6日航班为同一航线，需单独购票（日期不同）。票价约301欧元/人（约328美元）。请提前2小时到达机场办理值机。

jade_chengdu_to_beijing.name_base: Chengdu to Beijing (Jade return for class)
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.name_local: 成都 → 北京（Jade返京上课）
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.notes_base: Jade returns to Beijing on May 9 for class (May 9 class day). Flight 3U8893 dep 16:30 arr 19:00 (150 min). Alternative: earlier 3U8895 dep 18:00 or 3U8899 dep 20:30 if morning panda base visit runs late. EUR 301 per person (~USD 328). Matilde stays in Chengdu for panda base visit.
jade_chengdu_to_beijing.notes_local: Jade于5月9日（上课日）返京。推荐3U8893航班16:30出发、19:00抵达（150分钟）。若上午大熊猫基地行程延误，可改乘18:00（3U8895）或20:30（3U8899）航班。票价约301欧元/人（约328美元）。Matilde留在成都参观大熊猫繁育研究基地。

location_change.notes_base: Matilde only (Jade does not visit Xi'an). Chengdu-Xi'an HSR (opened 2020) takes approximately 3h30min-4h. Train G82 departs Chengdu East 08:55, arrives Xi'an North ~12:28 (213 min, second class ~CNY 234). Alternative: G308 dep 07:40, arr 11:04. Book on 12306.cn. Xi'an North Station is ~30 min by metro/taxi from city center. Note: Gaode Maps route showed connecting train D974 - recommend booking direct G-train on 12306 instead.
location_change.notes_local: 仅Matilde乘坐（Jade不去西安）。成渝至西安高铁（2020年开通）约需3.5-4小时。推荐G82次列车，成都东站08:55发车，约12:28抵达西安北站（213分钟，二等座约234元）。备选：G308次07:40出发，11:04抵达。请在12306.cn购票。西安北站距市中心约30分钟（地铁/出租车）。

location_change.name_base: Xi'an to Shanghai (Matilde) / Beijing to Shanghai (Jade)
location_change.name_local: 西安→上海（Matilde）/ 北京→上海（Jade）
location_change.type_local: 国内航班（两段独立航班）
location_change.company_base: China Southern Airlines (Matilde) / China Eastern Airlines (Jade)
location_change.company_local: 南方航空（Matilde）/ 东方航空（Jade）
location_change.departure_point_base: Xi'an Xianyang Airport (XIY) for Matilde; Beijing Capital Airport (PEK) for Jade
location_change.departure_point_local: 西安咸阳国际机场（XIY，Matilde）；北京首都国际机场（PEK，Jade）
location_change.arrival_point_base: Shanghai Pudong Airport (PVG) for Matilde; Shanghai Hongqiao Airport (SHA) for Jade
location_change.arrival_point_local: 上海浦东国际机场（PVG，Matilde）；上海虹桥机场（SHA，Jade）
location_change.notes_base: Two separate flights converging on Shanghai. MATILDE: CZ5792 XIY->PVG dep 10:30 arr 13:05 (155 min), EUR 135/person (~USD 147). Budget pick: 3U3269 dep 17:20 arr 19:50 at EUR 121 (~USD 132) if afternoon arrival preferred. JADE: MU5154 PEK->SHA dep 11:30 arr 13:35 (125 min), EUR 275/person (~USD 300). Coordinate arrival times so both reach the Bund area before evening. Note: Matilde at PVG, Jade at SHA - different airports, ~45min apart by taxi. Agree meeting point in central Shanghai.
location_change.notes_local: 两段独立航班在上海会合。Matilde：CZ5792 西安-浦东，10:30出发，13:05到达（155分钟），约135欧元/人（约147美元）。如需下午到达可选3U3269，17:20出发，19:50抵达（121欧元/约132美元）。Jade：MU5154 北京-虹桥，11:30出发，13:35到达（125分钟），约275欧元/人（约300美元）。注意：Matilde在浦东，Jade在虹桥，两机场相距约45分钟车程，请提前约定市区会合地点。

location_change.notes_base: Both Matilde and Jade travel together. Fuxing Hao high-speed train, one of China's fastest (350 km/h). G44 dep Shanghai Hongqiao 09:00, arr Beijing South ~13:28 (268 min, ~CNY 553 second class per person). Arrive Beijing by early afternoon, leaving time for Forbidden City / Temple of Heaven and evening Michelin dinner. Book on 12306.cn at least 2-3 weeks in advance - very popular route. Alternative: G2 dep 09:00 or other G trains on the same corridor.
location_change.notes_local: Matilde和Jade同行。复兴号高铁，最高时速350公里。G44次09:00上海虹桥出发，约13:28抵达北京南站（268分钟，二等座约553元/人）。午后抵京，可游览故宫/天坛，晚上享用米其林餐厅晚餐。建议提前2-3周在12306.cn购票，此线路极为热门。
